name: Osh (Kyrgyzstan)

colors.symbolism: the tunduk, the crown of the Kyrgyz yurt

description: A white field with a light-blue sky in the upper fly, separated from the white by a broken line representing the Sulayman-Too mountain; a red tunduk (yurt crown) at the hoist.
history: Adopted by the city of Osh on 25 October 2011 (designer Adil Sabirov). Osh is a city of republican significance administered separately from the surrounding Osh Region, which has no distinct flag of its own; the city flag is commonly shown for the region as well.

features.role: silhouette of Sulayman-Too against a light-blue sky
features.symbolism: the sacred Sulayman Mountain rising over the city
